title: Sri Kavindra Teerthara Aradhana
shloka:
ವೀ೦ದ್ರಾರೂಢ ಪದಾಸಕ್ತ೦ ರಾಜೇ೦ದ್ರ ಮುನಿಸೇವಿತ೦ 
ಶ್ರೀ ಕವೀ೦ದ್ರ ಮುನಿ೦ ವ೦ದೇ ಭಜತಾ೦ ಚ೦ದ್ರ ಸನ್ನಿಭ೦ ||
description: Known in poorvashrama as Sri Vasudevashastry, Sri Kaveendra Theertha was a learned disciple of Sri Vidyadhiraja Theertha. The Guru Charitre records that he received the Mahasamsthana, led it from 1392 to 1398, and was laid to rest beside Sri Padmanabha Theertha’s Brindavana after his Aradhana.

title: Sri Muneendra Teerthara Aradhana
shloka:
ರಾಮಪದಾ೦ಬುಜಾಸಕ್ತ೦ ರಾಘವೇ೦ದ್ರಗುರುಪ್ರಿಯ೦
ಮುನೀ೦ದ್ರಯೋಗಿನ೦ ಸೇವೇ ಕಾಮಿತಾರ್ಥ ಪ್ರದಾಯಕ೦ ||
 ||
description: Sri Muneendra Theertha is remembered among the students prepared by Sri Raghavendra Theertha for the study and continuation of Sri Raghavendra Theertha’s works. His Aradhana is observed at Srirangam.

title: Sri Sushameendra Teerthara Aradhana
shloka:
ಸುಧೀಜನಸುಮಂದಾರಂ ಸುಧೀಂದ್ರಸುತಸುಪ್ರಿಯಮ್
 ಸುಶಮೀಂದ್ರಗುರುಂ ವಂದೇ ಸುಜಯೀಂದ್ರಕರೋದ್ಭವಮ್ ||
description: Sri Sushameendra Theertha, known in poorvashrama as Sri Suprajnendracharya, received sanyasa from Sri Sujayeendra Theertha. The Guru Charitre records his work to strengthen education, publication and service initiatives connected with the Mutt. It also identifies his parents and records his installation of his Guru’s Brindavana.

biography.parents: Sri Raja Rajagopalacharya and Sri Padmavathibai

title: Sri Vageesha Teerthara Aradhana
shloka:
ವಾಸುದೇವಪದದ್ವ೦ದ್ವವಾರಿಜಾಸಕ್ತಮಾನಸ೦
 ಪದವ್ಯಾಖ್ಯಾನಕುಶಲ೦ ವಾಗೀಶಯತಿಮಾಶ್ರಯೇ ||
description: Sri Vageesha Theertha received sanyasa from Sri Kaveendra Theertha and continued the Mahasamsthana lineage during a difficult period after the separation of the Sri Rajendra and Sri Kaveendra lines. He stabilised and reorganised its resources, remained close to Vijayanagar, and furthered Madhwa philosophy. He selected Sri Madhavashastry, later Sri Ramachandra Theertha, as successor and entrusted the Mahasamsthana to him.

title: Sri Subodhendra Teerthara Aradhana
shloka:
ಸುಧಾಸೇವಾಸಮೂದ್ಭೂತಾ ಸುಖಸ೦ವಿತ್ಸುಮಾಶ್ರಮ೦ 
ಸುಜನಾಭೀಷ್ಟದಾತಾರ೦ ಸುಭೋದೇ೦ದ್ರ ಗುರು೦ಭಜೇ ||
description: Sri Subodhendra Theertha, known in poorvashrama as Sri Muddukrishnacharya, received sanyasa from Sri Bhuvanendra Theertha and led the Mahasamsthana from 1799 to 1835. The Guru Charitre records his tours, the development of patronage for the Mutt, and his giving of sanyasa to Sri Sujanendra Theertha. It records his final years at Nanjanagud.

title: Sri Vidyadhiraja Teerthara Aradhana
shloka:
ಮಾದ್ಯದದ್ವೈತ್ಯ೦ಧಕಾರ ಪ್ರದ್ಯೋತನಮಹರ್ನಿಶ೦
 ವಿದ್ಯಾಧಿರಾಜ ಸುಗುರು೦ ಹೃದ್ಯಾಮಿತ ಗುರು೦ ಭಜೇ ||
description: Sri Vidyadhiraja Theertha, known in poorvashrama as Sri Krishnabhatta, is described as a great scholar. The Guru Charitre records his four-year stewardship of the Mahasamsthana, his Aradhana at Yaragola, and his giving of sanyasa to Sri Kaveendra Theertha and Sri Rajendra Theertha.

biography.ashramaShishya: Sri Kaveendra Theertha and Sri Rajendra Theertha

title: Sri Ramachandra Teerthara Aradhana
shloka:
ದ್ಯುಮಣ್ಯಬೀಜನಾಬ್ದಿ೦ದು೦ ರಾಮವ್ಯಾಸಪದಾರ್ಚಕ:
 ರಾಮಚ೦ದ್ರ ಗುರುರ್ಭ್ರುಯಾತ್ ಕಾಮಿತಾರ್ಥ ಪ್ರದಾಯಕ: ||
description: Sri Ramachandra Theertha continued the task entrusted by Sri Vageesha Theertha: strengthening the Madhwa community and maintaining harmony among its lineages. He travelled across the Vijayanagar kingdom, took part in scholarly assemblies, and recognised Sri Raghunatha Bhatta’s learning. He selected him as successor, giving him sanyasa and the name Sri Vibudhendra Theertha.

title: Sri Suvrateendra Teerthara Aradhana
shloka:
ಸುಶೀಲೇ೦ದ್ರ ಕರಾಬ್ಜೋತ್ಥ೦ ಸುಶಾ೦ತ್ಯಾದಿಗುಣಾರ್ಣವ
ಸುಧಾಪ್ರವಚನಾಸಕ್ತ೦ ಸುವ್ರತೀ೦ದ್ರ ಗುರು೦ ಭಜೇ ||
description: Sri Suvrateendra Theertha, known in poorvashrama as Sri Huli Krishnacharya, received sanyasa from Sri Susheelendra Theertha. The Guru Charitre records his stewardship from 1926 to 1933, his commitment to japa, pooja, teaching and scholarly gatherings, and his giving of sanyasa to Sri Suyameendra Theertha.

title: Sri Bhuvanendra Teerthara Aradhana
shloka:
ಭೂದೇವ ವ೦ದ್ಯ ಪಾದಾಬ್ಜ೦ ಭೂತಿಮ೦ತಮಭೀಷ್ಟದ೦ 
ಭೂತಲೇ ಸಾಧುವಿಖ್ಯಾತ೦ ಭುವನೇ೦ದ್ರ ಗುರು೦ಭಜೇ ||
description: Sri Bhuvanendra Theertha is described as an able administrator and scholar. The Guru Charitre records that he learnt administration from Sri Varadendra Theertha and Shastra from Sri Dheerendra Theertha, supported Haridasa literature, and developed the Mutt through gifts and formal records. He gave sanyasa to Sri Vyasatattvajna and Sri Subodhendra Theertha.

biography.ashramaShishya: Sri Vyasatattvajna Theertha and Sri Subodhendra Theertha

title: Sri Sureendra Teerthara Aradhana
shloka:
ಯಶ್ಚಕಾರೋಪವಾಸೇನ ತ್ರಿವಾರ೦ ಭೂ ಪ್ರದಕ್ಷಿಣ೦ 
ತಸ್ಮೈ ನಮೋ ಯತೀ೦ದ್ರಾಯ ಶ್ರೀ ಸುರೇ೦ದ್ರ ತಪಸ್ವಿನೇ ||
description: Sri Sooreendra Theertha, known in poorvashrama as Sri Vasudevacharya, received the Mahasamsthana after Sri Yogeendra Theertha. The Guru Charitre records his stewardship from 1688 to 1692, his passing at Madurai on Jyestha Shuddha Dwitiya, and the succession of Sri Sumatheendra Theertha.

title: Sri Vadeendra Teerthara Aradhana
shloka:
ವ೦ದಾರುಜನಸ೦ದೋಹ ಮ೦ದಾರುತರು ಸನ್ನಿಭ೦ 
ವೃ೦ದಾರಕ ಗುರುಪ್ರಖ್ಯ೦ ವ೦ದೇ ವಾದೀ೦ದ್ರ ದೇಶಿಕ೦ ||
description: Sri Vadeendra Theertha, known in poorvashrama as Sri Purushottamacharya, received sanyasa from Sri Upendra Theertha. The Guru Charitre records his stewardship from 1728 to 1750, his literary work, and his role in giving sanyasa to Sri Vasudhendra Theertha. It records his Brindavana at Mantralaya.

title: Sri Vijayeendra Teerthara Aradhana
shloka:
ಭಕ್ತಾನಾ೦ ಮಾನಸಾ೦ ಭೋಜಭಾನವೇ ಕಾಮಧೇನವೇ 
ಭಜತಾ೦ ಕಲ್ಪತರವೇ ಜಯೀ೦ದ್ರ ಗುರವೇ ನಮ: ||
description: Sri Vijayeendra Theertha was a distinguished scholar formed under Sri Vyasaraja Theertha. In poorvashrama as Sri Vittalacharya, he studied Vedavedanga, Nyaya, Itihasa, Meemamsa and other Shastras, received sanyasa as Sri Vishnutheertha, and later received Pattabhisheka from Sri Surendra Theertha. Sri Sudheendra Theertha became his Uttaradhikari.

title: Sri Susheelendra Teerthara Aradhana
shloka:
ಸುಧಾದ್ಯಮಲಸದ್ಬೋಧ೦ ಸುಕೀರ್ತಿವಿಲಸದ್ದಿಶ೦ 
ಸುಧೀಸ೦ಸ್ತುತ್ಯಸುಗುಣ೦ ಸುಶೀಲೇ೦ದ್ರ ಗುರು೦ ಭಜೇ ||
description: Sri Susheelendra Theertha was a leading figure in Madhwa learning in the early twentieth century. He supported the publication of Madhwa Siddhanta works, taught students who later became scholars, and encouraged scholarly exchange through the Srimath Sameera Samaya Samvardhini Sabha. He also worked to bring different Madhwa lineages together and undertook extensive tours after taking ashrama.

title: Sri Varadendra Teerthara Aradhana
shloka:
ವಾದೇವಿಜಯಶೀಲಾಯ ವರದಾಯ ವರಾರ್ಥಿನಾ೦ 
ವದಾನ್ಯ ಜನಸಿ೦ಹಾಯ ವರದೇ೦ದ್ರಾಯ ತೇ ನಮ: ||
description: Sri Varadendra Theertha was a scholar, teacher and administrator who worked to establish Dwaitha Siddhanta in Pune. He studied under Sri Vadeendra Theertha, received sanyasa from Sri Vasudhendra Theertha, and supported students who later became recognised scholars. His period included tours, debates and the growth of the Mutt.

title: Srimattikacharya Aradhana
shloka:
ಯಸ್ಯ ವಾಕ್ಕಾಮಧೇನುರ್ನಃ ಕಾಮಿತಾರ್ಥಾನ್ಪ್ರಯಚ್ಛತಿ |

ಸೇವೇ ತಂ ಜಯಯೋಗೀಂದ್ರಂ ಕಾಮಬಾಣಚ್ಛಿದಂ ಸದಾ ||
description: Sri Jayateertha, reverentially known as Teekakritpada or Teekacharya, received sanyasa from Sri Akshobhya Theertha. The Guru Charitre records his leadership from 1365 to 1388, his detailed commentaries on Sri Madhwacharya’s works, and his role in making their philosophical teaching accessible to later students. It identifies Sri Vidyadhiraja Theertha as successor and Sri Vyasatheertha as another disciple.

title: Sri Raghavendra Teerthara Aradhana
shloka:
ದುರ್ವಾದಿಧ್ವಾ೦ತರವಯೇ ವೈಷ್ಣವೇ೦ದೀವರೇ೦ದವೇ 
ಶ್ರೀ ರಾಘವೇ೦ದ್ರ ಗುರವೇ ನಮೋ ಅತ್ಯ೦ತ ದಯಾಲವೇ ||
description: Sri Raghavendra Theertha was a scholar, teacher, writer and devoted spiritual guide in the direct Madhwa lineage. Known in poorvashrama as Sri Venkatanatha Bhatta, he received ashrama from Sri Sudheendra Theertha. Sri Yogeendra Theertha was his Ashrama Shishya, and Moola Mantralaya is his Vrundavana place.

title: Sri Sugnanendra Teerthara Aradhana
shloka:
ಸುಧಾಸಾರಾರ್ಥ ತತ್ವಜ್ಞ೦ ಸುರದ್ರುಮಸಮ೦ಸತಾ೦ 
ಸುರಾಧಿಪ ಗುರುಪ್ರಖ್ಯ೦ ಸುಜ್ಞಾನೇ೦ದ್ರ ಗುರು೦ ಭಜೇ ||
description: Sri Sugnanendra Theertha was a Dwaitha scholar who studied under Sri Subodhendra Theertha before receiving sanyasa from Sri Sujanendra Theertha. He resided at Nanjanagud, taught students, conducted Srimannyayasudha mangala, and restored several Mutt villages and lands during his administration.

title: Sri Vyasatatvajna Teerthara Aradhana
shloka:
ಪ್ರಕಟೀಕೃತಟೀಕೋಕ್ತಿರ್ಮಕಟೀಕೃತಮಾಯಿರಾಟ್ |

ಚಕೃತಾವ್ಯಾಸತತ್ವಜ್ಞಮಕರೀಂದ್ರ  ಕೃಪಾಮಯಿ |
description: Sri Vyasatattvajna Theertha, known in poorvashrama as Sri Venkataramacharya, received sanyasa from Sri Bhuvanendra Theertha. The Guru Charitre describes him as a scholar and devotee, records his association with Gopaladasa, his Kannada Devaranamas under the ankita Vasudevavitthala, and a number of named works. It identifies Sri Vishnutheertha as his student.

title: Sri Madhava Teerthara Aradhana
shloka:
ಸಾಧಿತಾಖಿಲ ಸತ್ತತ್ವ೦ ಬಾಧಿತಾಖಿಲ ದುರ್ಮತ೦
 ಬೊಧಿತಾಖಿಲ ಸನ್ಮಾರ್ಗ೦ ಮಾಧವಾಖ್ಯ ಗುರು೦ ಭಜೇ ||
description: Sri Madhava Theertha received sanyasa directly from Sri Madhwacharya and later became head of the Samsthana after Sri Padmanabha Theertha and Sri Narahari Theertha. He spread Tattva Siddhanta, initiated Sri Madhuhari Theertha, and handed the Hamsa Peetha to Sri Akshobhya Theertha.

biography.vrundavanaPlace: Kampli, on the banks of the Tungabhadra

title: Sri Sukrateendra Teerthara Aradhana
shloka:
ಸುವಿದ್ವತ್ಕಮಲೋಲ್ಲಾಸ ಮಾರ್ತಾ೦ಡ೦ ಸುಗುಣಾಕರ೦
 ಸಚ್ಛಾಸ್ತ್ರಾಸಕ್ತ ಹೃದಯ೦ ಸುಕೃತೀ೦ದ್ರ ಗುರು೦ ಭಜೇ ||
description: Sri Sukruteendra Theertha, known in poorvashrama as Sri Venugopalacharya, is described as a scholar of four Shastras. The Guru Charitre records his study under Sri Nyamagondlu Shamacharya and Sri Huli Hanumanthacharya, his stewardship from 1903 to 1912, and his entrusting of the Mahasamsthana to Sri Susheelendra Theertha.

biography.vidyaGuru: Sri Nyamagondlu Shamacharya and Sri Huli Hanumanthacharya

title: Sri Vasudhendra Teerthara Aradhana
shloka:
ವಸುಧಾತಲ ವಿಖ್ಯಾತ೦ ವೈರಾಗ್ಯಾದಿ ಗುಣಾರ್ಣವ೦
 ವೇದವೇದಾ೦ಗ ಚತುರ೦ ವಸುಧೇ೦ದ್ರ ಗುರು೦ ಭಜೇ ||
description: Sri Vasudhendra Theertha was an ascetic and scholar who spent much of his period at Mantralaya in japa, discourses and teaching. Sri Vadeendra Theertha gave him sanyasa, and he learnt Shastras while accompanying his Guru on sanchara. His period also saw the restoration of Mutt property and gifts made to the Mutt.

title: Sri Sumateendra Teerthara Aradhana
shloka:
ಪೂರ್ಣಪ್ರಜ್ಞಮತಾ೦ಬೊಧಿ ಪೂರ್ಣೇ೦ದುಮಕಲ೦ಕಿನ೦
 ಸುಜನಾ೦ಬುದಿಭಾಸ್ವ೦ತ೦ ಸುಮತೀ೦ದ್ರ ಗುರು೦ ಭಜೇ ||
description: Sri Sumatheendra Theertha, known in poorvashrama as Sri Mudduvenkatakrishnacharya, is described as a scholar and administrator. The Guru Charitre records his study under Sri Raghavendra Theertha, sanyasa from Sri Sooreendra Theertha, efforts to regulate Mutt customs, and the succession of Sri Upendra Theertha.

title: Sri Raghunandana Teerthara Aradhana
shloka:
ಪರೈರಪಹೃತಾ ಮೂಲರಾಮಾರ್ಚಾ ಗುರ್ವನುಗ್ರಹಾತ್ 
ಯೇನಾನೀತಾ ನಮಸ್ತಸ್ಮೈ ರಘುನ೦ದನ್ ಭಿಕ್ಷವೇ ||
description: Sri Raghunandana Theertha, known in poorvashrama as Sri Ramachandracharya, received sanyasa from Sri Jitamitra Theertha. The Guru Charitre records his leadership from 1492 to 1504, his work in the Mahasamsthana, and his final days near Chakra Theertha at Hampi. Sri Surendra Theertha received sanyasa from him.

title: Sri Sujanendra Teerthara Aradhana
shloka:
ಸುಯುಕ್ತಿಜಾಲಸಹಿತ೦ ಸುಜನಾಮೋದಕಾರಿಣ೦ 
ಸುರೋತ್ತಮ ಗುರುಪ್ರಖ್ಯ೦ ಸುಜನೇ೦ದ್ರ ಗುರು೦ಭಜೇ ||
description: Sri Sujanendra Theertha, known in poorvashrama as Sri Jayaramacharya, received sanyasa from Sri Subodhendra Theertha at Bommaghatta. The Guru Charitre records his subsequent study of Nyayashastra in Pune, his work for the Mutt, and Sri Sugnanendra Theertha as his disciple. It records his Brindavana at Nanjanagud.

title: Sri Padmanabha Teerthara Aradhana
shloka:
ಪೂರ್ಣಪ್ರಜ್ಞ ಕೃತ೦ ಭಾಷ್ಯಾಮಾದೌ ತದ್ಭಾವಪೂರ್ವಕ೦ 
ಯೋ ವ್ಯಾಕರೋನ್ನಮಸ್ಮೈ ಪದ್ಮನಾಭಾಖ್ಯ ಯೋಗಿನೇ ||
description: Sri Padmanabha Theertha was appointed by Sri Madhwacharya to lead the newly formed Dwaitha school after him. In poorvashrama as Sri Shobana Bhatta, he was a learned scholar who accepted Sri Madhwacharya’s Siddhanta after sustained debate, took sanyasa, and devoted his life to studying and propagating that philosophy. Sri Narahari Theertha was his Patta Shishya and Sri Lakshmidhara Theertha his Ashrama Shishya.

title: Sri Vibhudendra Teerthara Aradhana
shloka:
ಅಕೇರಲ೦ ತಥಾ ಸೇತು೦ ಮಾಗ೦ಗ೦ ಚ ಹಿಮಾಲಯ೦ 
ನಿರಾಕೃತಾದ್ವೈತ ಶೈವ೦ ವಿಭುದೇ೦ದ್ರ ಗುರು೦ ಭಜೇ ||
description: Sri Vibudhendra Theertha was a leading exponent of Dwaitha philosophy and the eleventh Peetadhipathi of the Dakshinaadhi Kaveendra Mutt. His life included learning, scholarly travel and debates. Sri Ramachandra Theertha selected him as successor, and Sri Jitamitra Theertha was his Ashrama Shishya.

title: Sri Sugunendra Teerthara Aradhana
shloka:
ಸುಧರ್ಮೇ೦ದ್ರ ಕರಾಬ್ಜೋಥ್ಥ೦ ಸುವಿದ್ವನ್ಮಣಿರಾಜಿತ೦
 ಸುಮೃಷ್ಟಾನ್ನಪ್ರದಾತಾರ೦ ಸುಗುಣೇ೦ದ್ರ ಗುರು೦ ಭಜೇ ||
description: Sri Sugunendra Theertha, known in poorvashrama as Sri Venkataramacharya, received sanyasa from Sri Sudharmendra Theertha. The Guru Charitre records his stewardship from 1872 to 1884, relief work during famine, administrative efforts to safeguard Mutt lands and records, and his giving of sanyasa to Sri Suprajnendra Theertha.

title: Sri Akshobhya Teerthara Aradhana
shloka:
ಯೋ ವಿದ್ಯಾರಣ್ಯ ವಿಪಿನ೦ ತತ್ವಮಸ್ಸಿನಾಛ್ಛಿನತ
 ಶ್ರೀಮದಕ್ಷೋಭ್ಯತೀರ್ಥಾಯ ನಮಸ್ತಸ್ಮೈ ಮಹಾತ್ಮನೇ ||
description: Sri Akshobhya Theertha, known in poorvashrama as Sri Govindabhatta, received sanyasa from Sri Madhwacharya and became Mahasamsthanadhipathi in 1350. The Guru Charitre records his teaching of Vedanta to Sri Jayatheertha, the philosophical debate at Mulbagal, and his final days at Malkheda on the Kaginee River.

biography.ashramaShishya: Sri Jayatheertha, Sri Thrylokyabhooshanatheertha and Sri Lokapujya

title: Sri Upendra Teerthara Aradhana
shloka:
ಕೃಪಾರಸಾಮೃತಾ೦ಬೊಧಿಮಪಾರಮಹಿಮಾನ್ವಿತ೦
 ಉಪಾಸ್ಮಹೇ ತಪೋಮೂರ್ತಿ೦ ಉಪೇ೦ದ್ರಗುರುಪು೦ಗವ೦ ||
description: Sri Upendra Theertha, known in poorvashrama as Sri Vijayeendracharya, received sanyasa from Sri Sumatheendra Theertha. The Guru Charitre records his brief stewardship from 1725 to 1728, his reputation for scholarship and discourse, and Sri Vadeendra Theertha as his disciple and successor.

title: Sri Jitamitra Teerthara Aradhana
shloka:
ಸಪ್ತರಾತ್ರ೦ ಕೃಷ್ಣವೇಣ್ಯಾ ಮುಶಿತ್ವಾ ಪುನರುಥ್ಥಿತ೦ 
ಜಿತಾಮಿತ್ರ ಗುರು೦ ವ೦ದೇ ವಿಭುದೇ೦ದ್ರ ಕರೋದ್ಭವ೦ ||
description: Sri Jitamitra Theertha was the twelfth Peetadhipathi of the Dakshinaadhi Kaveendra Mutt. In poorvashrama as Sri Anantappa, he served Sri Vibudhendra Theertha and worshipped Sri Narasimha Saligrama before receiving ashrama. Sri Raghunandana Theertha was his Ashrama Shishya, and Jitamitra Gaddi is his place of disappearance.

biography.placeOfDisappearance: Jitamitra Gaddi, on the banks of the Krishna–Bheema Sangama

title: Sri Sudharmendra Teerthara Aradhana
shloka:
ಸುಧಾ೦ಶುಮಿವ ಸ೦ಭೂತ೦ ಸುಜ್ಞಾನೇ೦ದ್ರ ಸುಧಾ೦ಬುಧೌ 
ಸುಧೀಸ೦ದೋಹಸ೦ಸೇವ್ಯ ಸುಧರ್ಮೇ೦ದ್ರ ಗುರು೦ ಭಜೇ ||
description: Sri Sudharmendra Theertha was a Sanskrit grammar scholar in poorvashrama as Sri Ganeshaacharya. Sri Sugnanendra Theertha appointed him as successor and gave him the name Sri Sudharmendra Theertha. He resided at Mantralaya and entered Brindavana there on Pushya Bahula Panchami.

title: Sri Suyameendra Teerthara Aradhana
shloka:
ಸುಖತೀರ್ಥ ಮತಾಬ್ದೀ೦ದು೦ ಸುಧೀ೦ದ್ರಸುತಸೇವಕ೦ 
ಸುಧಾಪರಿಮಳಾಸಕ್ತ೦ ಸುಯಮೀ೦ದ್ರ ಗುರು೦ಭಜೇ ||
description: Sri Suyameendra Theertha, known in poorvashrama as Sri Srinivasamurthyacharya, received sanyasa from Sri Suvrateendra Theertha. The Guru Charitre records his leadership from 1933 to 1967, work on the development of Mantralaya, welfare and educational initiatives, and the succession of Sri Sujayeendra Theertha.

title: Sri Surendra Teerthara Aradhana
shloka:
ಯಶ್ಚಕಾರೋಪವಾಸೇನ ತ್ರಿವಾರ೦ ಭೂ ಪ್ರದಕ್ಷಿಣ೦
 ತಸ್ಮೈ ನಮೋ ಯತೀ೦ದ್ರಾಯ ಶ್ರೀ ಸುರೇ೦ದ್ರ ತಪಸ್ವಿನೇ ||
description: Sri Surendra Theertha, known in poorvashrama as Sri Venkatakrishnacharya, received sanyasa from Sri Raghunandana Theertha. The Guru Charitre records a long stewardship from 1504 to 1575, extensive tours, and the transition of the Mahasamsthana to Sri Vijayeendra Theertha.

title: Sri Narahari Teerthara Aradhana
shloka:
ಸಸೀತಾ ಮೂಲರಾಮಾರ್ಚಾ ಕೋಶೇ ಗಜಪತೇ ಸ್ಥಿತಾ 
ಯೇನಾನೀತಾ ನಮಸ್ತಸ್ಮೈ ಶ್ರೀಮನ್ ನೃಹರಿ ಭಿಕ್ಷವೇ ||
description: Sri Narahari Theertha was a distinguished disciple of Sri Madhwacharya, with contributions to philosophy, literature and public life. He brought the Sri Moola Rama and Sita idols from the Kalinga treasury, contributed to the Haridasa tradition, and served in Kalinga before returning to the work of Madhwa Siddhanta.

title: Sri Sujayendra Teerthara Aradhana
shloka:
ಸುಯಮೀ೦ದ್ರ ಕರಾಬ್ಜೋತ್ಥ೦ ಸುವಿದ್ಯಾಬೋಧಕ೦ ಸದಾ
 ಸುಮೂಲರಾಮ ಪೂಜಾಢ್ಯ೦ ಸುಜಯೀ೦ದ್ರ ಗುರು೦ ಭಜೇ ||
description: Sri Sujayeendra Theertha, known in poorvashrama as Sri Venkataraghavendracharya, received sanyasa from Sri Suyameendra Theertha. The Guru Charitre records his work in education, publishing and development at Mantralaya, and identifies Sri Sushameendra Theertha as his Ashrama Shishya. It records his Brindavana at Mantralaya.

title: Sri Yogeendra Teerthara Aradhana
shloka:
ಸಾ೦ದ್ರಬೊಧಾಯ ಶಾಸ್ತ್ರೇಷು ನಿಸ್ತ೦ದ್ರ ಮನಸೇ ಹರೌ 
ರಾಘವೇ೦ದ್ರ ಕುಮಾರಾಯ ನಮೋ ಯೋಗೀ೦ದ್ರ ಯೋಗಿನೇ ||
description: Sri Yogeendra Theertha received sanyasa from Sri Raghavendra Theertha in poorvashrama as Sri Venkannacharya. He prepared for regular Brindavana pooja after his Guru’s Brindavana Pravesha, undertook southern sanchara and Siddhanta prachara, and settled at Srirangam. Sri Sooreendra Theertha was his Ashrama Shishya.

title: Sri Supragnendra Teerthara Aradhana
shloka:
ಸುಧಾಜಿಜ್ಞಾಸಯಾ ಸರ್ವಸುಬುಧಾನ೦ದದಾಯಕಾನ್ 
ಸುಪ್ರಜ್ಞೇ೦ದ್ರಮುನಿ೦ ವ೦ದೇ ಸದಾ ವಿದ್ಯಾ ಗುರೂನ್ಮಮ ||
description: Sri Suprajnendra Theertha, known in poorvashrama as Sri Gururajacharya, received sanyasa from Sri Sugunendra Theertha. The Guru Charitre records his scholarship, patronage of learning, a royal invitation to Mysore, and his Brindavana at Nanjanagud on Magha Bahula Shashti.

title: Sri Vishnuteertha Aradhana
shloka:
ವಿಷ್ಣುತೀರ್ಥಃ ಕಲ್ಪವೃಕ್ಷೋ ವಿಷ್ಣುತೀರ್ಥಶ್ಚ ಕಾಮಧೃಕ್ ।

ಚಿಂತಾಮಣಿರ್ವಿಷ್ಣುತೀರ್ಥೋ ಯತೀಂದ್ರಃ ಕಾಮದಃ ।।
description: Guruparampara Aradhana

title: Sri Dheerendra Teerthara Aradhana
shloka:
ಧರಣಿಮ೦ಡಲೇಖ್ಯಾತ೦ ಧೈರ್ಯಾದಿಗುಣಬೃ೦ಹಿತ೦ 
ಧೀಕೃತಾಶೇಷವಾದೀಭ೦ ಧೀರಸಿ೦ಹ ಗುರು೦ ಭಜೇ ||
description: Sri Dheerendra Theertha, known in poorvashrama as Sri Jayaramacharya, was the son of Sri Vadeendra Theertha. The Guru Charitre records his scholarly writings, his short stewardship in 1785 after receiving the Mahasamsthana from Sri Bhuvanendra Theertha, and his Brindavana on the bank of the Varada River at Ritti.

title: Sri Sudheendra Teerthara Aradhana
shloka:
ಕುಶಾಗ್ರಮತಯೇ ಭಾನುದ್ಯುತಯೇ ವಾದಿ ಭೀತಯೇ 
ಆರಾಧಿತ ಶ್ರೀಪತಯೇ ಶ್ರೀಸುಧೀ೦ದ್ರ ಯತಯೇ ನಮ: ||
description: Sri Sudheendra Theertha received sanyasa from Sri Surendra Theertha and studied all Shastras under Sri Vijayeendra Theertha. His literary and scholarly work spans Shastras, poetry, drama and Alankara. Sri Raghavendra Theertha and Sri Yadavendra Theertha were his Ashrama Shishyas, and his Vrundavana is at Navavrundavana, Anegondi.

title: Sri Suyateendra Teerthara Aradhana
shloka:
ಸುಶಮೀಂದ್ರ ಕರಾಬ್ಜೋತ್ಥಂ ರಾಘವೇಂದ್ರ ಗುರುಪ್ರಿಯಂ 
ಸುಯತೀಂದ್ರ ಗುರುಂ ವಂದೇ ಮೂಲರಾಮಾರ್ಚನೆ ರತಮ್ ||
description: Sri Suyateendra Theertha, known in poorvashrama as Sri Susheelendracharya, received sanyasa from Sri Sushameendra Theertha. The Guru Charitre records his education under Sri Suyameendra Theertha and Archak Ramacharya, and traces his family background through Sri Ananthacharya and Sri Yamunabai.
